barRaise.reconcileNote:
Close leg, run first. Every openFindings id was matched against both the live queue and the archive, filtered to items tagged for this project and dated at or after the finding's first sighting. Four came back closed and every one was verified against the code by a separate read-only pass rather than trusted on its closure note: `maintainability-01` (billing gate test exists and preship gate 8e runs it), `reliability-01` (the refund and dispute branch calls the cancel helper at worker/src/handlers/billing.js:953), `sync-04` (migration 0025 plus the watermark-gated conditional update at src/cloud.ts:990-994) and `gate-page-publish-01` (the required check is armed with admin enforcement, confirmed against the live branch-protection state). All four dropped from openFindings. `gate-page-publish-01` is re-filed under the same id for the part that is genuinely still open, which is that nothing notices when the resulting pull request never merges.

One claim carried into this run did not survive checking. The orchestrator told the work-queue-hygiene and skill-chain-handoff lenses that recent auto-enqueued Chains rows came out with empty title, notes and prompt. Both lenses checked all thirteen live Chains rows and it does not reproduce: every one carries a non-blank prompt. The real and much smaller gap is that three of them carry no `title` field at all, which is neither a documented field nor one the queue writer validates. The empty-notes pattern is real on the Budget side, not here.
